disposition_reason: The original four-class PhysioNet-MI endpoint, participant split and numeric REVE-Base result are recoverable. A same-task design is defensible, but historical preprocessing, run aggregation and checkpoint/recipe parity remain unresolved; the extensive local source proposal is not an executed author baseline.

source_paper.title: REVE: A Foundation Model for EEG – Adapting to Any Setup with Large-Scale Pretraining on 25,000 Subjects

evidence.supports: Defines the PhysioNet-MI classification task, participant split, declared preprocessing and REVE-Base score.
Identifies the original 109-participant EEG motor movement/imagery dataset and 64 EEG channels.

evidence.locator: tasks; files_dict; EDF conversion and event-to-label loop, lines 33–44 and 127–158
evidence.supports: Pins the six imagery runs, participant split, channel order and released preprocessing; exposes a difference from the paper’s intermediate 128 Hz step.

evidence.locator: Downstream training, Optuna search and saved checkpoint evaluation; src/dt.py and src/eval_dt.py routes
evidence.supports: Author route exists for preprocessing, linear-probe/full fine-tuning and evaluation; exact historical run/checkpoint identities are not supplied by these commands.

target.description: Four-class motor-imagery classification: left fist, right fist, both fists and feet; the original PhysioNet-MI downstream endpoint, not MAE reconstruction or few-shot transfer.

dataset.description: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset v1.0.0; paper reports 9,837 four-second examples. Raw/derived content manifests still need admission.

cohort.description: All 109 source participants, with no extra subject exclusions or smaller cohort; imagery runs 04, 06, 08, 10, 12 and 14.

split.description: Source participants 1–70 train, 71–89 validation and 90–109 test. Retain this complete participant partition; a new subject/montage split is an extension.

inputs.description: The same 64-channel four-second EEG windows and electrode positions. Match the released REVE-Base pretrained access and original downstream label availability; no additional target-person calibration may enter this comparison.

preprocessing.description: Paper C.5 specifies loading at 128 Hz after a 64 Hz low-pass then resampling to 200 Hz. Pinned released script instead average-references, high-passes at 0.3 Hz, notches 60 Hz and resamples directly to 200 Hz. Resolve which historical recipe produced Table 12, including bad-channel interpolation, event/window completeness and geometry.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy is mean class recall, (1/4) sum_c TP_c/(TP_c+FN_c), higher is better. Cohen kappa and weighted F1 are separately reported supporting metrics, not substitute winning endpoints.

aggregation.description: Table 12 reports REVE-Base 0.6480 ± 0.0140 as mean ± standard deviation. Original seed/run roster and exact pooled-test versus participant reduction must be bound; the registration’s participant-level wording alone cannot establish paper parity.

published_baseline.description: Table 12 REVE-Base, PhysioNet-MI balanced accuracy 0.6480 ± 0.0140 (reported standard deviation); this is a published aggregate, not a local rerun.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author preprocessing/training/evaluation routes are identified, but no authenticated same-protocol downstream checkpoint or rerun result is established. Local spectral/ridge/NCM helpers cannot replace REVE-Base.

minimum_effect.rationale: A practically meaningful gain must be set after historical run variability and classification error impact are quantified; the published standard deviation is not a minimum-effect threshold.

uncertainty.method: Before admission, freeze paired candidate/author evaluation over the original test participants and matched training seeds; retain original paper score aggregation and report participant-cluster uncertainty. Exact confidence rule and replication remain unresolved.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant for generalization; training seed is a separate algorithmic-variation axis.
uncertainty.rationale: Epochs within a participant are dependent; source aggregate standard deviation does not establish independent participant uncertainty.

paper_win_requires: Recover and bind the precise Table 12 preprocessing, all eligible epochs, original run aggregation and REVE-Base access.

Exceed the source-paper balanced accuracy and a calibrated author rerun under identical original subjects, runs, labels, preprocessing and inputs, by the predeclared justified effect with uncertainty.
Freeze candidate and hyperparameters using only participants 1–89 before final evaluation on all source test participants 90–109.
Do not treat better frozen-feature, few-shot, altered-montage, smaller-cohort or new-split results as a Table 12 paper win.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparison is distinct from current SOTA; no current-SOTA search or claim is admitted by this contract.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate on original training and validation participants; retain adaptation curves only as separately identified source endpoints.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model/checkpoint, preprocessing, class/window manifests, label/pretraining access, hyperparameters, seeds, stopping rules and metric aggregation before test scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: One protected evaluation phase on the complete original test partition after exact author calibration and uncertainty/effect policies are accepted.
episode.baseline_policy: Calibrate against the original REVE-Base Table 12 recipe; distinguish published 0.6480, the author rerun and other models. A successful numerical reconstruction is calibration only. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Paper versus released PhysioNet preprocessing discrepancy is unresolved.
Original Table 12 seed/run roster, exact score aggregation and downstream checkpoint/recipe binding are absent.
No authentic author reproduction, admitted working evaluator, fixed access/resource budgets, justified effect or uncertainty decision rule.
Released-model identity, original data completeness and pretraining/downstream exposure require manifests; the retained REVE source package has external dependencies and disabled execution.

legacy.notes: Preserve all REVE S8 reconstruction and engineering materials. The local package covers many tasks and explicitly disables execution; its authored fixed references and prospective endpoints are calibration/development components and do not demonstrate a PhysioNet-MI paper win.
